esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from SDA to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from SCLK to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x48. Added the tc74.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the temperature set on the slider, rounded down like the chip: passes
